name: state_cleanup
description: requestAnimationFrame used in code with PAUSED state but no cancelAnimationFrame
source: Section 3.2 Direction 3 — 集成链路强制检查 #3: 状态切换副作用
rationale: Tower Stack 3D fatal bug: requestAnimationFrame kept running in PAUSED state because the code only had `if (state !== PAUSED) return` instead of cancelAnimationFrame. This caused CPU drain and visual freeze on pause.
